```{r load data}
library(dplyr)

srt <- readRDS("D:/ATR_bioinformatics/processed_data/Seurat/ImmuneAging.rds") %>%
  subset(subset = cell_label %in% c("lateMacs", "repMacs", "intMacs", "regMacs 1", "regMacs 2", "infMacs"))
```

```{r features selected by differential gene expression testing}
Seurat::Idents(srt) <- 'Condition'

model <- 'MAST'

features <- Seurat::FindMarkers(srt,
                        ident.1 = 'Old', 
                        ident.2 = 'Young',
                        assay = 'RNA',
                        logfc.threshold = 0.3,
                        test.use = 'MAST'
                        )

var_selected <- rownames(features)

saveRDS(var_selected, paste0("D:/ATR_bioinformatics/analysis/DisTwiner/downstreamFunctionalAnalysis/selectedFeatures/", 
           model, 
           ".rds"))
```

```{r venn diagram of selected features for each model}
features_disTwiner <- readRDS("D:/ATR_bioinformatics/analysis/DisTwiner/realDataBenchmarking/selectedFeatures/distwiner.rds")
features_EN <- readRDS("D:/ATR_bioinformatics/analysis/DisTwiner/realDataBenchmarking/selectedFeatures/elasticNet.rds")
features_MAST <- readRDS("D:/ATR_bioinformatics/analysis/DisTwiner/downstreamFunctionalAnalysis/selectedFeatures/MAST.rds")

# install.packages("ggVennDiagram")
library(ggVennDiagram)

# List of items
x <- list(DisTwiner = features_disTwiner, ElasticNet = features_EN, MAST = features_MAST)

# 3D Venn diagram
pdf("D:/ATR_bioinformatics/analysis/DisTwiner/downstreamFunctionalAnalysis/selectedFeatures/feature_selection_venn.pdf")
ggVennDiagram(x)
dev.off()
```

```{r gsea - distwiner features}
model <- "disTwiner"

genes_selected <- features_disTwiner

library(msigdbr)

### HALLMARK

gene_sets = msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "mouse", category = "H")
msigdbr_list = split(x = gene_sets$gene_symbol, f = gene_sets$gs_name)

Seurat::Idents(srt) <- 'Condition'

markers <- Seurat::FoldChange(srt,
                      ident.1 = 'Old', 
                      ident.2 = 'Young',
                      assay = 'RNA',
                      features = genes_selected
                      )

ranks <- markers$avg_log2FC
names(ranks) <- rownames(markers)

fgseaRes <- fgsea::fgsea(pathways = msigdbr_list,
                  stats = ranks,
                  minSize=10,
                  maxSize=500,
                  nproc=1,
                  scoreType="std")

fgseaResTidy <- fgseaRes %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(desc(NES))

library(ggplot2)

pdf(paste0("D:/ATR_bioinformatics/analysis/DisTwiner/downstreamFunctionalAnalysis/GSEA/", model,"_Hallmark.pdf"))
ggplot(fgseaResTidy %>% dplyr::filter(abs(NES) > 1), aes(reorder(pathway, NES), NES)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill=padj<0.05)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x="Pathway", y="Normalized Enrichment Score",
       title=paste0(paste0("Old vs Young"))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10))
dev.off()

saveRDS(fgseaResTidy, (paste0("D:/ATR_bioinformatics/analysis/DisTwiner/downstreamFunctionalAnalysis/GSEA/", model, "_HallmarkPathways.rds")))
```

```{r fit distwiner and elastic net based on genes pre-selected by MAST}
srt_select <- srt[features_MAST,]
```

```{r prepare data for new fit}
xdata <- t(as.matrix(Seurat::GetAssayData(srt_select, assay = "RNA", "data")))

xdata <- xdata[,sapply(seq(ncol(xdata)), function(ix) {sd(xdata[,ix])}) != 0]

ydata <- c(rep(0, length(srt_select$Condition)))
for (i in 1:length(srt_select$Condition)) {
  ydata[i] <- 0*(unname(srt_select$Condition)[i] == "Young") + 1*(unname(srt_select$Condition)[i] == "Old")
}

ydata <- as.numeric(ydata)

ylabel <- as.character(unname(srt_select$cell_label))

data <- data.frame(xdata, y = ydata, label = ylabel)

rm(srt_select)

itrain <- sort(sample(nrow(xdata), nrow(xdata)*.9))
```

```{r build correlation matrices for new fit}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# this part should receive an arbitrary number of matrices
groups <- unique(data[,'label'])
group_list <- list()

for (i in 1:length(groups)) {
  group_list[[i]] <- data[which(data[,'label'] == groups[i]),!colnames(data) %in% c("y", "label")]
}

# filter genes with no sample variability
for (i in 1:length(groups)) {
  group_list[[i]] <- group_list[[i]][,sapply(seq(ncol(group_list[[i]])), function(ix) {sd(group_list[[i]][,ix])}) != 0]
}

# select only common genes between groups
col_common = colnames(xdata)
for (i in 1:length(group_list)){
  col_common = intersect(col_common, colnames(group_list[[i]]))
}

group_list <- lapply(group_list, function(x) x[, col_common])

xdata <- scale(xdata[, col_common])

# normalizing data
group_list <- lapply(group_list, scale)

## correlation matrices
group_cor <- lapply(group_list, function (x) propagate::bigcor(x, y = NULL, fun = "cor", size = 2000, verbose=FALSE))
group_cor <- lapply(group_cor, function (x) as.data.frame(ff::as.ffdf(x)))
group_cor <- lapply(group_cor, function (x) x %>% mutate(across(everything(), replace_na, 0)))
# group_cor <- readRDS("group_correlation_mat_macs.rds")
```

```{r MAST + distwiner features}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

model = "MAST_distwiner"
group_combs <- combn(length(group_cor),2)
n_feats <- dim(xdata)[2]
ang_weight_mat = matrix(0, nrow = dim(group_combs)[2], ncol = n_feats) 
for (i in 1:n_feats){
  for (k in 1:dim(group_combs)[2]) {
    ang_weight_mat[k,i] <- exp(1 - acos(lsa::cosine(group_cor[[group_combs[1,k]]][,i],group_cor[[group_combs[2,k]]][,i]))/pi)
  }
}

ang_weight_mat[is.na(ang_weight_mat)] <- 0

ang_weight <- apply(ang_weight_mat, 2, function(x) min(x[x > 0])) 

rm(group_cor, group_list, group_combs, data, ang_weight_mat)
gc()

#Train model and save
fit_EN_cv_oldyg <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(xdata[itrain,], as.factor(ydata[itrain]), family="binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, penalty.factor=ang_weight, type.measure="mse")

saveRDS(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, paste0("D:/ATR_bioinformatics/analysis/DisTwiner/downstreamFunctionalAnalysis/trainedModels/", 
           model, 
           ".rds"))

#selected features
var_selected_idx <- which(fit_EN_cv_oldyg$glmnet.fit$beta[,which(fit_EN_cv_oldyg$cvm == min(fit_EN_cv_oldyg$cvm))] != 0)
var_selected <- colnames(xdata)[var_selected_idx]
saveRDS(var_selected, paste0("D:/ATR_bioinformatics/analysis/DisTwiner/downstreamFunctionalAnalysis/selectedFeatures/", 
           model, 
           ".rds"))
```
